# Women's Health Magazine

> > Women's Health is a leading lifestyle magazine covering fitness, nutrition, health, beauty, and wellness for women, featuring expert advice, workout programs, and evidence-based health information.

Published by Hearst, Women's Health provides comprehensive content on women's wellness including specialized programs like BUILD & BURN, WH+ membership offerings, and coverage of critical health topics from reproductive health to menopause care. The magazine features expert contributors and offers both US and UK editions.

## Key Topics

- Fitness training and workout programs
- Nutrition and healthy eating
- Women's reproductive health
- Menopause and hormone health
- Mental health and wellness
- Body recomposition and strength training
- Beauty products and routines
- WH+ membership programs
- Health supplements and GLP-1 drugs
- Bodyweight exercises
- Upper-body strength training
- Lifestyle and relationships
- COVID-19 and public health
- Diet strategies (intermittent fasting, Mediterranean diet)
- Wellness authority and longevity

## Main Content Hubs

- [Women's Health - Fitness, Nutrition, Sex, and Weight Loss Tips for Women](https://womenshealthmag.com): Homepage featuring latest fitness, nutrition, beauty & wellness content
- [Health, Wellness & Healthy Living Advice](https://womenshealthmag.com/health): Health hub covering GLP-1 drugs, menopause, mental health & wellness advice
- [Fitness Advice, Workout Tips, and More](https://womenshealthmag.com/fitness): Fitness hub with BUILD & BURN programs, workout challenges & training plans
- [Food Recipes, Ideas, and Healthy Eating](https://womenshealthmag.com/food): Food hub with healthy recipes, protein guides & 7-day eating reset plans
- [The Ultimate Guide to Diets: What Really Works for Women](https://womenshealthmag.com/diets): Diet guide covering intermittent fasting, Mediterranean & metabolic diets
- [Women's Health UK Edition](https://womenshealthmag.com/uk): UK edition featuring longevity training, Pilates & wellness authority

## Workout Guides & Exercise Tutorials

- [How To Do A Push-Up: A Guide To Form, Benefits, And Variations](https://womenshealthmag.com/fitness/a20702206/how-to-pushup): Push-up tutorial with form tips, modifications & Mel Robbins challenge
- [Crush Your First Pull-Up With The WH Ultimate Pull-Up Plan](https://womenshealthmag.com/fitness/a64242460/ultimate-pull-up-plan): WH+ six-week science-backed program to master first unassisted pull-up
- [Beginner Workout Tips: How To Start Exercising And Stick With It](https://womenshealthmag.com/fitness/a65611670/how-to-start-working-out-beginner-tips): Beginner guide with expert tips to start fitness routine & build strength
- [How To Do A Handstand: Workout Tips, Trainer Advice](https://womenshealthmag.com/fitness/a69125140/how-to-do-a-handstand-workout-tips): Handstand tutorial with Kyle Weiger's training tips & balance techniques
- [Forward Lunge Form Tips For Sculpted Glutes, Strong Legs, and Safer Knees](https://womenshealthmag.com/fitness/a65205518/forward-lunge-guide): Forward lunge guide with form fixes, modifications & lower-body benefits
- [How To Do A Kettlebell Swing, Snatch, Clean, And More: Video Tutorial](https://womenshealthmag.com/fitness/a69731757/kettlebell-swing-clean-snatch-form-fixes-build-and-burn): Kettlebell form tutorial covering swing, snatch & clean techniques

## Health & Wellness Articles

- [Abortion Is A Common, Safe Practice That's Almost Never Regretted](https://womenshealthmag.com/health/a36847773/what-to-know-about-abortion): Article on abortion access, telemedicine restrictions & personal stories
- [Measles Cases Are Rising in the U.S. — Here's What to Know](https://womenshealthmag.com/health/a70606289/measles-rising-us-data-2026): CDC data on 2026 measles outbreak surge & vaccination prevention tips
- [What's Happening with the Estrogen Patch Shortage in the U.S.?](https://womenshealthmag.com/health/a70517796/estrogen-patch-shortage): Menopause care disruption from estrogen patch shortage & alternatives
- [How To Get Rid Of A Cough In 5 Minutes - Home Remedies For Coughs](https://womenshealthmag.com/health/g39629324/how-to-get-rid-of-a-cough-in-5-minutes): Quick cough relief remedies including hydration & salt water gargle tips
